units.source_text: 不，别有所误解……我和你之间，从一开始就没有任何契约关系。

en.t: No, do not misunderstand... from the very beginning, there was never any contractual relationship between you and me.

units.source_text: 既然没有契约关系，当然也就不可能有毁约的事。

en.t: Since there was no contractual relationship, naturally there could be no question of breaking a contract.

units.source_text: 而且，我这头也并不是没有一点儿损失。

en.t: Besides, it is not as if I have suffered no loss at all on my side.

units.source_text: 譬如，那个，一星期一次，像从堆肥里榨出的烧酒的气味……

en.t: For example, that thing, once a week, the smell of liquor as if squeezed out of compost...

units.source_text: 看起来像雨水槽似的有弹性的肌肉，浮起在你大腿内侧……

en.t: Those resilient muscles like rain gutters, rising up along the inside of your thighs...

units.source_text: 蘸着唾沫，擦拭黑橡皮似的下体，清洗皱折里囤积的沙子时，那种不知羞耻的感触……

en.t: That shameless sensation when, wetting it with saliva, wiping the lower body like black rubber, and washing away the sand stored in the folds...

units.source_text: 而且，还把这些看作更猥亵的东西，那种羞答答的笑……

en.t: And then that shy smile, treating all of this as something even more obscene...

units.source_text: 其他全部算起来，该是个不小的数字。

en.t: If everything else is counted too, it should add up to no small number.

units.source_text: 你就是不相信，那也是事实。

en.t: Even if you do not believe it, that is still the truth.

units.source_text: 男人具有比女人更沉溺于破碎片断的倾向。

en.t: Men have a greater tendency than women to become absorbed in broken fragments.
